pages.text: Pocket peeks out of the backpack. The Space Needle pokes up into the soft grey clouds. "Hello, Seattle," says Pocket. Look and look.
Whoosh! At Pike Place Market, a shiny silver fish flies through the air. The fishmonger catches it. Pocket's ears wiggle.
Buckets and buckets of flowers! Pink, yellow, and red. Pocket sniffs and sniffs. "Hello, Seattle," says Pocket. Look and look.
Pocket spots a coffee cup on a bench. Steam curls up from the lid, up and up, into the drizzle.
Pitter, patter, pitter, patter. Umbrellas bloom along the street, red, yellow, and green. "Hello, Seattle," says Pocket. Look and look.
A big green ferry glides across Puget Sound. Pocket watches it go, slow and steady, across the shining water.
The rain stops. The clouds part, and there is Mount Rainier, big and quiet, with a snowy white top.
Puff! Far out on the water, an orca rises, black and white and gentle. "Hello, Seattle," says Pocket. Look and look.
Whirr, whirr. Pocket rides the monorail high over the street. Rooftops glow pink and gold below.
The lights come on, one by one. The Space Needle twinkles. "Hello, Seattle," says Pocket. Look and look.
The lights twinkle. Pocket yawns a big, slow yawn. One ear droops. Then the other.
Pocket is tucked up on the windowsill bed, fast asleep. Goodnight, Pocket. Goodnight, Seattle.
